messages.text: Thursday, October 8 · Canton, Michigan
Autumn Sky, Ancient Myths, and First Responder Support

A mostly clear autumn day offers a high near 70°F, perfect for enjoying local events or looking skyward. This week, state funding is directed towards first responder mental health, and NASA's Roman telescope clears a major review.
Expect a mostly clear day with a high near 70°F and a low around 49°F, with no chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:39 AM and sunset is at 7:03 PM, under a waning crescent moon with 6.6% illumination.
Arts and Music Around Town

In Ypsilanti, the EMU Theatre presents 'Metamorphoses' at the Sponberg Theatre at 7:00 PM. For music lovers, Jordan Blanchard plays a free happy hour concert at Ann Arbor's North Star Lounge starting at 5:30 PM.
Pop's birthday is coming up on October 12.
State Funds for First Responder Mental Health

A statewide initiative to support the mental health of first responders will receive $1.044 million. Funds will be awarded to Frontline Strong Together for police officers, firefighters, EMS personnel, and other critical support staff.
Looking Ahead: Music and History
Tomorrow, catch Scythian at The Ark in Ann Arbor at 8:00 PM, or explore history with the 'If Stones Could Talk' Oakwood Cemetery Tours in Northville starting at 5:00 PM.
Autonomous Navigation and Telescope Readiness

NASA's Starling satellites successfully demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and object catalogs. The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has also cleared its flight-readiness review, targeting an August 30 launch.
The schedule for Starship's next launch is unset.
Seek out a quiet moment of observation today.
Friday, October 9 · Canton, Michigan
Overcast skies, local history, and a whisper of deep space
An overcast day in Canton offers a chance to explore local history or enjoy live music. The most consequential local thread involves state funding for essential services.
Expect an overcast day with a high near 71°F and a low around 44°F, with a 4% chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:40 AM and sunset is at 7:02 PM, under a new moon with 2.3% illumination.
Local experiences and nearby happenings

In Northville, the If Stones Could Talk Oakwood Cemetery Tours begin at 5:00 PM, offering a blend of history and art. For music lovers, William Hooker Quartet performs at Kerrytown Concert House in Ann Arbor at 7:00 PM.
Pop's Birthday is on October 12.
State funding allocations for essential services

Recent state funding announcements include $1.044M for first responder mental health initiatives and $1.3M for low-income workers' health coverage. Additional allocations support workforce development and housing in various regions.
Looking ahead to tomorrow and beyond
Tomorrow, consider the "Party of the Century" at The Senate Theater in Detroit or the "WOMXNHOUSE Detroit" art exhibition opening. The EMU Theatre presents "Metamorphoses" in Ypsilanti.
Satellites navigate without GPS, Hubble spots ancient merger

NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and object catalogs. The Hubble telescope has identified a major merger from the Milky Way's infancy, providing evidence of its assembly history.
The next Starship launch is estimated to be no earlier than September 18, 2026.
A quiet moment can hold a universe of discovery.
